text: {"intents": [{"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "times": 2, "by": "21:30", "why": "Corvin was standing within 2 m of the hut not half an hour ago, so I want my eyes on it while the evening goes dark."}, {"activity": "visit_plaza", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "22:30", "why": "I've earned a short spell with the neighbours after a day of stone and standing watch."}, {"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "23:45", "why": "One last look over the hut before midnight so I know it's standing when I turn in."}], "tasks": {"open": [{"goal": "Keep the small hut standing at (25, 510, 36) and raise it again the moment it's taken down", "why": "Corvin tore my first hut down once and I hold enough stone and limestone to put it back at once, so I won't be caught short again.", "steps": [{"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "why": "Stand by the hut and watch for Corvin coming back toward it."}, {"activity": "build_hut", "object": null, "why": "If it's gone, rebuild it straight away from the stone and limestone I'm holding."}]}], "drop": []}, "cannot_yet": [{"want": "Get a straight answer out of Corvin about why they took my hut down", "why": "They came near and left again without a word, and I can't make them explain themselves."}]}
